name: 65065 · Osage Beach, MO
findings: ZIP 65065 (Osage Beach) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 65065 (Osage Beach) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 65065 (Osage Beach) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
